summary: The AI/tech selloff kept going: chips, networking and AI-capex builders fell 10-30% over five days, all far above sticker, so price noise (METHOD 7). In the buy range no dossier trigger was newly tripped; SMCI's Q1 cash-burn and debt PROBLEM stands (AVOID). To check: MELI credit provisions and margin, NRDS revenue miss vs guide, CRUS's soft Dec guide, SFM and PRDO (causes unconfirmed). TRV's 8-K is only a new director. Not investment advice.

items.headline: Q1 10-Q trigger stands (OCF -$434M, debt $8.6B); stock -16% in 5 days
items.why: Dossier trigger 'debt above 3x FCF' tripped Nov 5; OCF negative quarter 1 of 4. Price drop is mostly the AI-hardware rout (METHOD 7). Still AVOID; price is 3x MOS.

items.headline: -13% after Q3 as margins narrow again; price $1,625
items.why: Earlier quarters show margin squeeze from credit-loss provisions (Q2 op margin 6.7% vs 12.2%); Q3 figures unconfirmed. Marker margin_stable under strain. Street cut targets but kept Buy (fear). Check provisions and credit quality in the 10-Q: growth spend (event check 3) or loan-book problem (check 6).

items.headline: Citi Sell ($207) is still the only news; price $250 vs MOS $269
items.why: Downgrade is fear, not a story change (InvestED 249). Dossier trigger: ending-ARR growth <6% two years; new CEO starts 1 Dec. Q4 ARR is the next data point. No breach.

items.headline: Q3 revenue $239.6M below guide of $244-260M; William Blair downgrade
items.why: Revenue missed its own guide; auto-insurance carrier spend was the earlier weak spot. Price $11.18 vs MOS $12.70. Check carrier timing (event check 3) vs lost share (moat, check 6). Truist cut target $15 to $12.

items.headline: Dec-quarter guide $510-570M (-7% y/y at midpoint); target cut 14%
items.why: Q2 revenue $559.5M flat y/y; gross margin helped by temporary wafer benefit; guide margin 51-53%. Customer concentration makes this a moat check (6): phone-cycle dip or share loss? Company gives no detail.

items.headline: 8-K item 5.02 is a new director (board 9 to 10), not an officer exit
items.why: Filing adds Lesley Goldwasser to the board. No management-integrity concern. Price 6.7x MOS, nothing to buy.

items.headline: -22% in 5 days after backlog slipped to $2.5B; price $344 vs MOS $25
items.why: Check award timing in the 10-Q (event checks 1, 6). Price is 14x MOS so no action in any case.

items.headline: -12% on Q3 miss from higher costs; price $38.76 vs MOS $23.86
items.why: Single-drug (Wakix) business; guide reportedly kept (unconfirmed). Check gross margin and patent timeline (event checks 3, 6).

items.headline: -10% despite Q3 beat; South University deal; cause unconfirmed
